$comment: Every figure behind index.html. confidence: published | corroborated | derived | estimated | unconfirmed. Update verified + source + confidence together, never a value alone.

reference_unit_cost.$comment: Rule 1 in AUDIT.md. These may fall between runs. They may not rise without a written explanation.

qwen3-coder-next.note: rate card on page understates at 0.50/1.20

minimax-m2.5.note: second rate card shows 0.36/1.44, exactly 20% higher, consistent with a gateway uplift

custom-model-import.note: assumes 2,000 tok/s per unit. AWS directs customers to their account manager rather than publishing it.

gpt-5.6-luna.note: GPT-5.6 Luna. Cut 80% from $1.00/$6.00 on 30 July 2026. Proprietary, so no weights, no adapters, no reserved capacity. Bedrock runs it on AWS-managed infrastructure with in-region processing; the model provider has no access to prompts or completions.

azure_ai_foundry.source: aggregator; Azure pricing pages render client-side and return placeholders to a fetch

llama-4-maverick.note: output below input is almost certainly transposed. Excluded from mixes.

gpt-5.6-luna.note: GPT-5.6 Luna. Microsoft matched the cut at parity, effective 1 August 2026.

azure_ai_foundry.note: DeepSeek V4 Pro and V4 Flash appear in the catalogue with no published rate. If priced, Azure's ceiling rises above 81%.

google_vertex.billing: per endpoint instance hour plus a per-model container fee. No per-token tier for open weights.
google_vertex.derivation: a4-highgpu-8g at $16.11/GPU-hour, divided by modelled serving throughput, divided again by 40% endpoint utilisation
google_vertex.excluded: per-model container fee, published per Marketplace listing. Google's real cost is higher than shown.
google_vertex.absent_openai: Vertex Model Garden carries no OpenAI proprietary models. Google cannot reach the Luna price or accuracy, so its Max case stays on open weights with best-of-three.

azure_foundry.note: No charge to create or run an agent. Customer brings Storage, Cosmos DB and AI Search.

aws_agentcore.note: Monthly charge against an accumulating balance. This is why the AWS memory line compounds, and it is the largest single driver of our AWS advantage. Check every run.

azure_assembled.note: Infrastructure comparison only. AgentCore performs extraction and consolidation a customer would build.

google_agent_engine.note: No monthly accrual, so this line does not compound.

aws_cloudwatch.note: Volume tiers exist ($0.50 to 10TB, then $0.25, $0.10, $0.05) but apply only to AWS vended logs. Agent payload arrives via PutLogEvents and bills flat.

azure_monitor.note: Not yet collected. Carried at AWS figures.

azure.note: Not yet collected. Carried at AWS figures.

gpu.$comment: Per node of 8 GPUs unless stated. The committed rates are the weakest figures in the model.

aws_p5_h100.note: 50% off list, assumed, never verified. Moves Akka cost by +/-39%. Highest-value figure to confirm.

google_a3_h100.note: Three-year CUD is 6%. The only committed rate of the three that is published rather than assumed.

google_a4_b200.note: $16.11 per GPU-hour. Excluded from CUD; Google routes A4 through AI Hypercomputer reservations.

lambda_h100_low.note: May be spot or promotional. Confirm it holds for a year.

gpu.market_note: AWS raised EC2 Capacity Block prices ~15% in January 2026 and ~20% in July 2026. Rates confirmed today should not be assumed to hold.

deepseek-v4-pro.note: highest verified open weight. Bedrock availability contested.

qwen3-8b-proxy.note: size-class proxy for models publishing nothing

best_of_three_uplift.note: anchored on a 77.2% model reaching 90.0% in an engineered scaffold. Never measured on our configuration. Applied to Max only, never to Akka.

gpt-5.6-luna.note: OpenAI published no SWE-bench Verified score for the GPT-5.6 family. Published instead: SWE-bench Pro 62.7%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 84.7%, Coding Agent Index 75, Intelligence Index 51. On SWE-bench Pro, Luna leads DeepSeek V4 Pro at 55.4% and MiniMax M3 at 59.0%, and V4 Pro scores 80.6% on Verified, so 88 is a reasoned placement rather than a measurement. One aggregator returns 96/92/86/67 for Luna on Verified, which is a garbled table and must not be used. Re-attempt every run.

serving_throughput.note: First-principles from FLOPs and HBM bandwidth. Never benchmarked. Our own analysis warned mixed sequence lengths land 1.5-2x worse. Benchmarking retires the largest single uncertainty in the model.

peak_factor.note: Measured for coding workloads across 44M requests in Microsoft's Azure inference traces. Measured at pooled scale, so a single tenant's true peak is higher.

akka_model.note_min_nodes: residency floor: both base models resident with HA across two zones

capacity_projection.note: Published as a commitment. Compounded modelled gain is 3.0x; we publish roughly half.
